Compare the final branch against current upstream main immediately before publication; reject unexpected ancestry, commit count, file count, or diff shape.

Keep open PRs and author-claimed local validation at zero outcome weight until external repository state changes.

Refresh duplicate and ownership checks after long repair cycles before republishing.
Verify catalogue/product-shape fit before submitting a demonstrator to a reusable-tools list.
Resolve maintainer-owned backport/release routing before opening stable-branch work.
